## Topics
- Why reproducibility matters in public health research
- Quarto documents: YAML, text, code chunks, rendering
- Version control with Git; GitHub repositories
- Commit, push, pull from RStudio

## Learning objectives
By the end of this module you should be able to:

- Render a Quarto document to HTML
- Control chunk output with execution options
- Clone a GitHub repo, commit changes, and push them back

## Data
`medicaldata::covid_testing`
